_about: Public-domain Samuel Logan Brengle (1860-1936, Salvation Army commissioner and holiness teacher) for the Word Hoard: The Way of Holiness and Heart Talks on Holiness (1918 editions), When the Holy Ghost is Come (1920 edition) and Love-Slaves (1923), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

brengle-way-of-holiness: The Way of Holiness, sixth edition (New York: Salvation Army Printing and Publishing House, 1918)
brengle-heart-talks: Heart Talks on Holiness, seventh edition (New York: Salvation Army Printing and Publishing House, 1918)
brengle-holy-ghost: When the Holy Ghost is Come, fifth edition (New York: Salvation Army Printing and Publishing House, 1920)

_alternates.brengle-pg: PG 6135, When the Holy Ghost is Come (source not stated)
_alternates.brengle-undated: Helps to Holiness and The Soul-Winner's Secret: title pages undated
